lead: Write a goal's acceptance fixture red, but never write its `nvs.toml` block red.
body: A `.nvs` fixture naming a missing member fails at `E0405` and costs only itself, but `deny_unknown_fields` sits on every struct in `crates/nvs-config/src/tree.rs`, so an unrecognised table fails at boot for every program in the repository. The config block belongs to the slice that adds the struct that reads it.
